prompts.body: Reconstruct the supplied bi-directional blueprint as a new viewpoint; do not reproduce the blueprint sheet, orthographic panels, grid, labels, dimensions, or multiple views. Output exactly one complete vehicle body in a clean three-quarter isometric studio perspective, showing the roof and both side/front forms. Keep the low aerodynamic End A and rugged tall End B recognizable. Remove every wheel, tire, and rim but preserve open wheel arches. Solid light-grey matte primer, uniform flat material, centered on a plain white background. No paint, decals, livery, logos, text, baked reflections, dramatic lighting, cast shadow, ground plane, or environment. Vehicle: {vehicle_id}.
prompts.wheel_a: Use the supplied vehicle blueprint as strict design reference. Produce one isolated modular End A aerodynamic wheel and rim in three-quarter view, axle horizontal, centered, complete circular geometry, neutral dark rubber and light-grey unpainted rim, plain background. No vehicle body, axle, suspension, logo, text, shadow, or environment.
prompts.wheel_b: Use the supplied vehicle blueprint as strict design reference. Produce one isolated modular End B rugged off-road wheel and rim in three-quarter view, axle horizontal, centered, complete circular geometry, deep tread, neutral dark rubber and light-grey unpainted rim, plain background. No vehicle body, axle, suspension, logo, text, shadow, or environment.
